limitations.text: The exact Commons file page identifies a modern Shuowen seal-style vector of 明 and states public-domain terms, but the original image request returned HTTP 429. Without access to its pixels, it is not selected as an educational glyph candidate. No character-specific Xiaoxuetang image URL was established.

Institutional accounts inspected here differ in their explanation of early 明 forms. The Sinica character record presents 日+月; the archaeological exhibition presents moon plus window and says 囧 could become graphically similar to 日. Their relative chronology and the disagreement remain unresolved here.
